question: Cari aktivitas meeting dari sales tim Account-Management yang durasinya di atas 60 menit.

question: Total nilai deal yang ditangani sales Outbound-Enterprise berapa?
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.rep_id IN (SELECT r.rep_id FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.team = 'Outbound-Enterprise')

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang punya lebih dari 6 deal.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING count() > 6)

question: Sales mana saja yang total omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset per sales?
sql: WITH rep_omset AS (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_omset.total_omset FROM rep_omset INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_omset.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE rep_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(rep_omset.total_omset) FROM rep_omset)

question: segmen apa aja yg rata2 nilai deal-nya di atas rata2 keseluruhan?
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment HAVING avg(d.value) > (SELECT avg(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL)

question: Siapa saja 10 pelanggan dengan omset terbesar? Cukup nama dan perusahaannya.
sql: SELECT c.name, c.company FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC LIMIT 10)

question: Rata-rata satu pelanggan punya berapa deal?
sql: SELECT round(avg(per_cust.jumlah_deal), 2) AS rata_rata_deal FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS per_cust

question: list customer yg udah pernah won tapi sekarang masih punya tiket urgent yg belum selesai
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress'))

question: Pelanggan aktif mana yang tidak ada aktivitas dalam 14 hari terakhir?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 14))

question: sales yg jumlah aktivitasnya di atas rata2 per sales siapa aja?
sql: WITH rep_act AS (SELECT a.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_act.jumlah_aktivitas FROM rep_act INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_act.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE rep_act.jumlah_aktivitas > (SELECT avg(rep_act.jumlah_aktivitas) FROM rep_act)

question: Bulan mana saja di tahun ini yang omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset bulanan tahun ini?
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) SELECT monthly.bulan, monthly.total_omset FROM monthly WHERE monthly.total_omset > (SELECT avg(monthly.total_omset) FROM monthly) ORDER BY monthly.bulan

question: rekap tiket per prioritas utk pelanggan yg churn
sql: SELECT t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned') GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Berapa rasio pelanggan yang pernah punya deal won dibanding seluruh pelanggan?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_pelanggan_won FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Pelanggan mana yang sudah membuat lebih dari 4 tiket support?
sql: WITH cust_ticket AS (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING jumlah_tiket > 4) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_ticket.jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_ticket ON c.customer_id = cust_ticket.customer_id

question: produk apa yg paling sering muncul di deal customer Enterprise? urutkan
sql: SELECT produk, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise') GROUP BY produk ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: Pelanggan yang deal terbesarnya pun masih di bawah rata-rata nilai deal, siapa saja?
sql: WITH cust_max AS (SELECT d.customer_id, max(d.value) AS deal_terbesar FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING deal_terbesar < (SELECT avg(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL)) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_max.deal_terbesar FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_max ON c.customer_id = cust_max.customer_id

question: Bandingkan rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket pelanggan Gold dengan rata-rata semua tiket.
sql: SELECT round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_gold, (SELECT round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL) AS rata_rata_semua FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold')

question: Hitung per wilayah pelanggan, berapa pelanggan yang belum punya deal sama sekali.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL) GROUP BY wilayah ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Siapa sales yang paling banyak menutup deal won?
sql: WITH rep_won AS (SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_deal_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id ORDER BY jumlah_deal_won DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_won.jumlah_deal_won FROM rep_won INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_won.rep_id = r.rep_id

question: pelanggan aktif yg aktivitas terakhirnya udah lebih dari 30 hari lalu, list dong
sql: WITH last_act AS (SELECT a.customer_id, max(a.timestamp) AS aktivitas_terakhir FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, last_act.aktivitas_terakhir FROM last_act INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON last_act.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND last_act.aktivitas_terakhir < subtractDays(now(), 30)

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang jumlah deal-nya di atas rata-rata jumlah deal per pelanggan.
sql: WITH per_cust AS (SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, per_cust.jumlah_deal FROM per_cust INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON per_cust.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE per_cust.jumlah_deal > (SELECT avg(per_cust.jumlah_deal) FROM per_cust)

question: berapa weighted pipeline dari customer yg dapet demo 30 hari terakhir?
sql: SELECT sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS weighted_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30))

question: Rekap jumlah tiket per status untuk pelanggan bertag high-value.
sql: SELECT t.status, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'high-value')) GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Sales mana yang rata-rata durasi aktivitasnya lebih lama dari rata-rata semua aktivitas?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING avg(a.duration_minutes) > (SELECT avg(a.duration_minutes) FROM activities AS a)

question: Pelanggan mana yang paling banyak bikin tiket?
sql: WITH cust_ticket AS (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_ticket.jumlah_tiket FROM cust_ticket INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON cust_ticket.customer_id = c.customer_id

question: win rate deal dari pelanggan wilayah APAC brp?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['region'] = 'APAC')

question: Berapa omset bulan ini dari pelanggan yang masih punya tiket terbuka?
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()) AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress'))

question: rekap jumlah deal per stage buat sales tim Outbound-Enterprise
sql: SELECT d.stage, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.rep_id IN (SELECT r.rep_id FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.team = 'Outbound-Enterprise') GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang punya tiket tapi semua tiketnya sudah resolved atau closed?

question: cari customer yg pernah dapet demo dan juga pernah meeting dalam 90 hari terakhir

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang punya deal aktif tapi tidak ada aktivitas apa pun dalam 30 hari terakhir.

question: Berapa persen aktivitas ke pelanggan aktif yang sentimennya positif?

question: Tampilkan deal yang nilainya di atas persentil 90 seluruh nilai deal.

question: tiket urgent yg penyelesaiannya lebih lama dari median tiket urgent, tampilkan

question: Rekap per bulan jumlah pelanggan baru dalam 180 hari terakhir yang sudah punya deal won.

question: Wilayah sales mana yang total omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset per wilayah?
sql: WITH region_omset AS (SELECT r.region, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region) SELECT region_omset.region, region_omset.total_omset FROM region_omset WHERE region_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(region_omset.total_omset) FROM region_omset) ORDER BY region_omset.total_omset DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang total nilai pipeline-nya lebih dari 1,5 juta?
sql: WITH cust_pipe AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING total_pipeline > 1500000) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_pipe.total_pipeline FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_pipe ON c.customer_id = cust_pipe.customer_id

question: 5 sales dgn aktivitas terbanyak siapa aja, sekalian timnya
sql: WITH top_rep AS (SELECT a.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, top_rep.jumlah_aktivitas FROM top_rep INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON top_rep.rep_id = r.rep_id ORDER BY top_rep.jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang deal pertamanya baru dibuat tahun ini?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING min(d.created_date) >= toStartOfYear(today()))

question: Ada berapa pelanggan churn yang masih dapat deal won dalam 365 hari terakhir?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractDays(now(), 365))

question: rata2 durasi aktivitas per tipe utk customer yg churn
sql: SELECT a.type, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a WHERE a.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned') GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY rata_rata_durasi DESC

question: Cari pelanggan yang punya deal dengan lebih dari 3 produk sekaligus.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE length(d.products_involved) > 3)

question: Tampilkan tiket dari pelanggan yang belum pernah dihubungi lewat call.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call')

question: Sales siapa saja yang pernah pegang deal milik pelanggan blacklisted?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'blacklisted'))

question: Bandingkan jumlah deal dari pelanggan yang pernah di-demo dan yang belum pernah di-demo.
sql: SELECT countIf(d.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo')) AS deal_dengan_demo, countIf(d.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo')) AS deal_tanpa_demo FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Berapa rata-rata hari closing deal won untuk pelanggan Enterprise?
sql: SELECT round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_rata_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise')

question: 10 tiket terbaru dari customer churn
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned') ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 10

question: sales yg masih pegang deal aktif tapi hari ini belum ada aktivitas sama sekali, siapa aja?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AND r.rep_id NOT IN (SELECT a.rep_id FROM activities AS a WHERE toDate(a.timestamp) = today())

question: sebaran sentimen aktivitas utk customer yg deal-nya lost kuartal ini
sql: SELECT a.sentiment, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a WHERE a.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) GROUP BY a.sentiment ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Hitung jumlah pelanggan per segmen yang punya tiket urgent belum selesai.
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Deal won terbesar tahun ini yang mana?
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) AND d.value = (SELECT max(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()))

question: Sales mana yang sudah menutup lebih dari 15 deal won tahun ini?
sql: WITH rep_won AS (SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_deal_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY d.rep_id HAVING jumlah_deal_won > 15) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_won.jumlah_deal_won FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_won ON r.rep_id = rep_won.rep_id

question: customer yg jumlah tiketnya di atas rata2 tiket per customer
sql: WITH cust_ticket AS (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, cust_ticket.jumlah_tiket FROM cust_ticket INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON cust_ticket.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE cust_ticket.jumlah_tiket > (SELECT avg(cust_ticket.jumlah_tiket) FROM cust_ticket)

question: Berapa rata-rata nilai deal per segmen, khusus pelanggan bertag retail?
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'retail')) GROUP BY c.segment

question: Sales mana yang punya deal di kelima stage?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id HAVING uniqExact(d.stage) = 5)

question: Pelanggan mana yang pernah won deal dengan Cloud-Storage-Pro dan juga dengan Analytics-Suite?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Cloud-Storage-Pro')) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Analytics-Suite'))

question: Pelanggan mana yang ditangani lebih dari 3 sales berbeda di deal-deal mereka?
sql: WITH cust_rep AS (SELECT d.customer_id, uniqExact(d.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING jumlah_sales > 3) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_rep.jumlah_sales FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_rep ON c.customer_id = cust_rep.customer_id

question: rata2 omset per sales di tiap tim berapa?
sql: WITH rep_omset AS (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.team, round(avg(rep_omset.total_omset), 2) AS rata_rata_omset FROM rep_omset INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_omset.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY rata_rata_omset DESC

question: Berapa total durasi aktivitas ke pelanggan yang punya deal di tahap proposal?
sql: SELECT sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a WHERE a.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'proposal')

question: Tiket terbuka dari pelanggan yang deal won-nya lebih dari 3, ada berapa?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING count() > 3)

question: urutkan wilayah pelanggan berdasarkan jumlah customer aktif yg punya deal aktif
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) GROUP BY wilayah ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Deal aktif mana yang dibuat sebelum deal won pertama kali ditutup?
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.created_date < (SELECT min(d.closed_date) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')

question: Sales mana yang win rate-nya di atas win rate keseluruhan?
sql: WITH rep_wr AS (SELECT d.rep_id, countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(rep_wr.win_rate, 2) AS win_rate_rep FROM rep_wr INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_wr.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE rep_wr.win_rate > (SELECT countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) FROM deals AS d FINAL)

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset per pelanggan, beserta segmennya.
sql: WITH cust_omset AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, cust_omset.total_omset FROM cust_omset INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON cust_omset.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE cust_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(cust_omset.total_omset) FROM cust_omset)

question: Bandingkan omset tahun ini dan nilai pipeline per wilayah pelanggan.
sql: WITH omset AS (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY wilayah), pipe AS (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY wilayah) SELECT omset.wilayah, omset.total_omset, pipe.total_pipeline FROM omset INNER JOIN pipe ON omset.wilayah = pipe.wilayah ORDER BY omset.total_omset DESC

question: deal yg nilainya di atas rata2 nilai deal di segmen customer-nya, list
sql: WITH seg_avg AS (SELECT c.segment, avg(d.value) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment) SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN seg_avg ON c.segment = seg_avg.segment WHERE d.value > seg_avg.rata_rata_nilai

question: Siapa sales dengan omset tertinggi di masing-masing wilayah sales?
sql: WITH rep_omset AS (SELECT r.region AS region, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region, r.rep_id, r.name) SELECT rep_omset.region, rep_omset.rep_id, rep_omset.name, rep_omset.total_omset FROM rep_omset WHERE (rep_omset.region, rep_omset.total_omset) IN (SELECT rep_omset.region, max(rep_omset.total_omset) FROM rep_omset GROUP BY rep_omset.region)

question: Tampilkan aktivitas paling baru untuk setiap tipe aktivitas.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE (a.type, a.timestamp) IN (SELECT a.type, max(a.timestamp) FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type)

question: Pelanggan aktif mana yang tahun lalu punya deal won tapi tahun ini belum ada deal won sama sekali?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today())) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()))

question: Berapa porsi omset yang datang dari 10 pelanggan dengan omset terbesar?
sql: WITH top_cust AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT round((SELECT sum(top_cust.total_omset) FROM top_cust) / (SELECT sum(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'), 2) AS rasio_omset_top10

question: segmen mana yg rasio churn-nya lebih tinggi dari rasio churn semua pelanggan?
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count(), 2) AS rasio_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment HAVING countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count() > (SELECT countIf(c.status = 'churned') / count() FROM customers AS c FINAL) ORDER BY rasio_churn DESC

question: Cari pelanggan yang lebih dari 40% aktivitasnya bersentimen negatif dan masih punya tiket terbuka.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') / count() > 0.4) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress'))

question: Rekap per bulan tahun ini: omset dan nilai deal baru yang dibuat.
sql: WITH omset AS (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan), baru AS (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS nilai_deal_baru FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) SELECT baru.bulan, omset.total_omset, baru.nilai_deal_baru FROM baru LEFT JOIN omset ON baru.bulan = omset.bulan ORDER BY baru.bulan

question: Berapa kontribusi omset tiap sales terhadap total omset timnya?
sql: WITH rep_omset AS (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id), team_omset AS (SELECT r.team, sum(rep_omset.total_omset) AS omset_tim FROM rep_omset INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_omset.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, round(rep_omset.total_omset / team_omset.omset_tim, 2) AS kontribusi FROM rep_omset INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_omset.rep_id = r.rep_id INNER JOIN team_omset ON r.team = team_omset.team ORDER BY r.team, kontribusi DESC

question: customer SMB yg rata2 nilai deal-nya lebih dari 1.5x rata2 nilai deal semua customer
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'SMB' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING avg(d.value) > 1.5 * (SELECT avg(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL))

question: Produk mana yang jumlah deal won-nya tahun ini di atas rata-rata per produk?
sql: WITH prod AS (SELECT produk, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY produk) SELECT prod.produk, prod.jumlah_deal FROM prod WHERE prod.jumlah_deal > (SELECT avg(prod.jumlah_deal) FROM prod) ORDER BY prod.jumlah_deal DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang punya tiket terbuka dan deal aktif, tapi tidak ada aktivitas dalam 30 hari terakhir?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30))

question: Bandingkan rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket antara pelanggan dengan omset di atas 1.000.000 dan pelanggan lainnya.
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING sum(d.value) > 1000000)), 2) AS rata_rata_omset_besar, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, t.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING sum(d.value) > 1000000)), 2) AS rata_rata_lainnya FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: Sales mana yang rata-rata lama closing deal won-nya lebih cepat dari rata-rata semua sales?
sql: WITH rep_closing AS (SELECT d.rep_id, avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)) AS rata_rata_hari FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id HAVING rata_rata_hari < (SELECT avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(rep_closing.rata_rata_hari, 2) AS rata_rata_hari_closing FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_closing ON r.rep_id = rep_closing.rep_id

question: list customer aktif di wilayah yg weighted pipeline-nya paling gede
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.attributes['region'] = (SELECT c.attributes['region'] FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY c.attributes['region'] ORDER BY sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) DESC LIMIT 1)

question: Rekap jumlah deal dan omset per tier untuk pelanggan yang sudah minimal 10 kali meeting.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, count() AS jumlah_deal, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting' GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING count() >= 10) GROUP BY tier ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Hitung per sales berapa aktivitas yang dilakukan ke pelanggan yang tidak pernah dia pegang deal-nya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE (a.rep_id, a.customer_id) NOT IN (SELECT d.rep_id, d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang pernah kalah deal (lost) tapi setelahnya berhasil won deal lain?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING countIf(d.stage = 'lost') > 0 AND maxIf(d.closed_date, d.stage = 'won') > minIf(d.closed_date, d.stage = 'lost'))

question: Ada berapa pelanggan per segmen yang aktivitas terakhirnya bersentimen negatif?
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative' AND (a.customer_id, a.timestamp) IN (SELECT a.customer_id, max(a.timestamp) FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id)) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Tampilkan tiket terbuka milik pelanggan yang total nilai deal-nya masuk 5% teratas.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING sum(d.value) >= (SELECT quantile(0.95)(cust_total.total_nilai) FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS cust_total))

question: Bandingkan win rate pelanggan tier Gold dengan pelanggan non-Gold.
sql: SELECT round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold')) / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold')), 2) AS win_rate_gold, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold')) / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold')), 2) AS win_rate_non_gold FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: sales mana yg omset kuartal ini di atas rata2 omset kuartal ini di timnya?
sql: WITH rep_q AS (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY d.rep_id), team_avg AS (SELECT r.team, avg(rep_q.total_omset) AS rata_rata_tim FROM rep_q INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_q.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_q.total_omset FROM rep_q INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_q.rep_id = r.rep_id INNER JOIN team_avg ON r.team = team_avg.team WHERE rep_q.total_omset > team_avg.rata_rata_tim

question: Pelanggan mana yang punya tiket urgent dengan waktu penyelesaian di atas rata-rata tiket urgent?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.resolution_time_hours > (SELECT avg(t.resolution_time_hours) FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent'))

question: Pelanggan mana yang jumlah deal-nya lebih banyak daripada jumlah tiketnya?
sql: WITH cust_deal AS (SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id), cust_ticket AS (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_deal.jumlah_deal, cust_ticket.jumlah_tiket FROM cust_deal INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON cust_deal.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN cust_ticket ON cust_deal.customer_id = cust_ticket.customer_id WHERE cust_deal.jumlah_deal > cust_ticket.jumlah_tiket

question: Berapa porsi nilai pipeline yang berasal dari pelanggan yang masih punya tiket terbuka?
sql: SELECT round(sumIf(d.value, d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress'))) / sum(d.value), 2) AS rasio_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: Pelanggan yang omset tahun ini sudah melebihi omset tahun lalu, siapa saja?
sql: WITH ytd AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS omset_tahun_ini FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY d.customer_id), lalu AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS omset_tahun_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, ytd.omset_tahun_ini, lalu.omset_tahun_lalu FROM ytd INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON ytd.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN lalu ON ytd.customer_id = lalu.customer_id WHERE ytd.omset_tahun_ini > lalu.omset_tahun_lalu

question: dari 10 customer omset terbesar, mana yg sekarang masih punya tiket terbuka?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC LIMIT 10) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress'))

question: Berapa kali lipat rata-rata nilai deal pelanggan bertag high-value dibanding rata-rata semua deal?
sql: SELECT round((SELECT avg(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'high-value'))) / (SELECT avg(d.value) FROM deals AS d FINAL), 2) AS rasio_nilai

question: Untuk 5 sales dengan omset terbesar, rekap jumlah aktivitas per tipe.
sql: WITH top_rep AS (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, a.type, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.rep_id IN (SELECT top_rep.rep_id FROM top_rep) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, a.type ORDER BY r.name, jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang satu deal terbesarnya menyumbang lebih dari setengah total omsetnya?
sql: WITH cust_share AS (SELECT d.customer_id, max(d.value) / sum(d.value) AS porsi FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING porsi > 0.5) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, round(cust_share.porsi, 2) AS porsi_deal_terbesar FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_share ON c.customer_id = cust_share.customer_id

question: Per segmen, ada berapa pelanggan yang omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset per pelanggan?
sql: WITH cust_omset AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM cust_omset INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON cust_omset.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE cust_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(cust_omset.total_omset) FROM cust_omset) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: brp persen nilai pipeline yg datang dari customer yg udah churn?
sql: SELECT round(sumIf(d.value, d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned')) / sum(d.value), 2) AS rasio_pipeline_churn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: Sales mana yang bulan ini belum ada deal lost sama sekali, tapi nilai pipeline-nya lebih dari 20 juta?
sql: WITH rep_pipe AS (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.rep_id HAVING total_pipeline > 20000000) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_pipe.total_pipeline FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_pipe ON r.rep_id = rep_pipe.rep_id WHERE r.rep_id NOT IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()))

question: Tiket mana yang penyelesaiannya lebih lama dari rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket dengan prioritas yang sama?
sql: WITH prio_avg AS (SELECT t.priority, avg(t.resolution_time_hours) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority) SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN prio_avg ON t.priority = prio_avg.priority WHERE t.resolution_time_hours > prio_avg.rata_rata_jam

question: Tim sales mana yang paling banyak menutup deal won, dan siapa saja anggotanya?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.team = (SELECT r.team FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 1)

question: Rata-rata berapa tiket per pelanggan, dipisah antara pelanggan yang pernah won dan yang belum?
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(cust_ticket.jumlah_tiket, cust_ticket.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')), 2) AS rata_rata_pernah_won, round(avgIf(cust_ticket.jumlah_tiket, cust_ticket.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')), 2) AS rata_rata_belum_won FROM (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS cust_ticket

question: Wilayah sales mana yang jumlah aktivitas positifnya per sales di atas rata-rata semua sales?
sql: WITH rep_pos AS (SELECT a.rep_id, countIf(a.sentiment = 'positive') AS jumlah_positif FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id) SELECT r.region, round(avg(rep_pos.jumlah_positif), 2) AS rata_rata_positif FROM rep_pos INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_pos.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region HAVING avg(rep_pos.jumlah_positif) > (SELECT avg(rep_pos.jumlah_positif) FROM rep_pos) ORDER BY rata_rata_positif DESC

question: rekap omset bulan lalu per segmen, cuma dari customer yg tiket-tiketnya ga pernah urgent
sql: SELECT c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()) AND d.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent') GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang total durasi aktivitasnya di atas rata-rata, tapi belum pernah punya deal won?
sql: WITH cust_dur AS (SELECT a.customer_id, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_dur.total_durasi FROM cust_dur INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON cust_dur.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE cust_dur.total_durasi > (SELECT avg(cust_dur.total_durasi) FROM cust_dur) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')

question: Sales mana yang omset tahun ininya di atas rata-rata, sekaligus jumlah aktivitas negatifnya di bawah rata-rata?
sql: WITH rep_omset AS (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY d.rep_id), rep_neg AS (SELECT a.rep_id, countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') AS jumlah_negatif FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_omset.total_omset, rep_neg.jumlah_negatif FROM rep_omset INNER JOIN rep_neg ON rep_omset.rep_id = rep_neg.rep_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_omset.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE rep_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(rep_omset.total_omset) FROM rep_omset) AND rep_neg.jumlah_negatif < (SELECT avg(rep_neg.jumlah_negatif) FROM rep_neg)

question: Hitung jumlah tiket per prioritas untuk 20 pelanggan dengan pipeline terbesar.
sql: SELECT t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC LIMIT 20) GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Berapa rata-rata omset per pelanggan untuk tiap tier, hanya pelanggan yang punya omset?
sql: SELECT cust_tier.tier, round(avg(cust_tier.total_omset), 2) AS rata_rata_omset FROM (SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tier, d.customer_id) AS cust_tier GROUP BY cust_tier.tier ORDER BY rata_rata_omset DESC
